newsitem.title: UK: Boy injured in suspected N. Ireland arson attack.
newsitem.headline: Boy injured in suspected N. Ireland arson attack.

text.p: A four-year-old boy was seriously injured in a suspected arson attack in the Northern Ireland town of Castledawson on Thursday, police said.

A Royal Ulster Constabulary spokesman said the child was in a critical condition in hospital with serious burns to his face after he and his mother were victims of a suspected arson attack on their home.
A fire officer said a neighbour rescued the boy from a bedroom and the mother was being treated for shock. He said an investigation was underway to establish how the blaze was started.
In Londonderry city, a family escaped unhurt when a petrol bomb was thrown into their home.
A police spokesman said the motive for the attacks was not known.
